title: How to Integrate Square with Squarespace as Payment Option Easily 2026
description:
Here is How to Integrate Square with Squarespace as Payment Option Easily 2026.

If you run an online store using Squarespace, connecting it to Square can streamline your checkout process and help you accept payments securely and easily.

This guide will walk you through the exact steps for a smooth Squarespace Square payment integration — whether you're setting up a new store or updating your existing one.


Step 1 – Log into Your Squarespace Account

Head to the Squarespace homepage and click on the Login button at the top right and proceed with details.
Once logged in, you’ll be on the dashboard. From here, select the website you want to work on — the one where you plan to connect Square to your Squarespace store.

Step 2 – Go to Settings

Inside your site dashboard, look to the left-hand menu and click on Settings.
This is where you manage everything from design to technical features like payment integrations for Squarespace Commerce.

Step 3 – Navigate to the Selling and Payments Section

In the Settings menu, find and click on Selling.
Next, select Payments — this is where you’ll configure how your store accepts money.

To use Square as a payment processor on Squarespace, click on the Square option in the list of providers.

Step 4 – Link Your Square Account

Now, you’ll be prompted to log into your Square account.
Make sure to enter the correct credentials tied to your business — this ensures proper syncing between both platforms.

After logging in, Squarespace will automatically connect with your Square account.
That’s it — you’ve now linked your Square account to Squarespace successfully.

Step 5 – Test Your Setup

To make sure everything works, go to your site’s checkout page and run a test transaction or check the payment method options.
With Square integrated, your customers will now have a smooth and secure checkout experience.

Why This Integration Matters

Using Square with Squarespace not only simplifies your payment process — it also gives you access to real-time sales tracking, easy refunds, and a powerful POS system.
If you’re selling both online and in person, this Square and Squarespace integration keeps everything in sync.

And that’s it!

If this Square and Squarespace integration guide helped you, make sure to like the video, subscribe to the channel.

title: How To Add Google Calendar To Squarespace Easy Integration 2026
description:
Here is the full procedure on How To Add Google Calendar To Squarespace Easy Integration 2026.

How to Add Google Calendar to Squarespace – Step-by-Step Tutorial

Welcome back to Endless Guides!
In today’s video, we’re going to show you how to add Google Calendar to your Squarespace website so you can keep your visitors updated with real-time events, appointments, and schedules.

Step 1: Log into your accounts
First, log in to your Squarespace account.
If this is your first time, click Create Account and follow the instructions on the screen.

Next, open a new tab and head to your Google Calendar.
This is where you’ll get the code to embed Google Calendar in Squarespace.

Step 2: Get your Google Calendar embed code
In Google Calendar, click the gear icon in the top right and select Settings.

From the left-hand side, scroll to the calendar you want to use.
Click the calendar name—for example, "Business Events" or "Class Schedule"—and then select Integrate Calendar.

Look for the Embed Code section.
This code will let you display a calendar on a Squarespace page.

You can customize the calendar appearance and choose whether to show one or multiple calendars.
Once ready, copy the embed code to your clipboard.

Step 3: Embed the calendar into Squarespace
Now, switch back to your Squarespace dashboard.

Go to the page where you want to show your calendar

Click Edit

Click Add Block, and then choose the Code Block

Click the pencil icon and paste the Google Calendar embed code

You’ll now see your live Google Calendar on your Squarespace site.
Feel free to drag the block and place it where it fits best.

Benefits of adding Google Calendar to Squarespace
By connecting Google Calendar to Squarespace, any updates you make to your calendar will automatically reflect on your website.
This means your visitors will always see the latest updates—whether it's appointments, webinars, classes, or public events.

It’s a perfect solution for anyone looking to add a live calendar to Squarespace and improve user engagement.

You can also use this to:

Create a public event calendar in Squarespace

Add a Google Calendar widget to your Squarespace homepage

Embed multiple calendars on different Squarespace pages

And that’s it!
Now you know how to integrate Google Calendar with your Squarespace website the right way.

If you found this guide helpful, don’t forget to like, subscribe, and check out our other videos on Squarespace customization and event management tools.

Thanks for watching, and we’ll see you in the next one!
